tpo_labeled_path.aggregation: ClickHouse sum(size) per price bin via fetch_volume_at_price
tpo_labeled_path.unit_per_bin: BTC base volume (not TPO bracket count)
tpo_labeled_path.poc_rule: max bin volume; tie-break center bin index
tpo_labeled_path.value_area_rule: expand from POC toward larger neighbor until 70% total volume
tpo_labeled_path.tie_break: expand toward larger neighbor bin volume
tpo_labeled_path.note: OA module docstring: volume-based market profile, not classic TPO

volume_profile_path.aggregation: Python dedup trade_id then sum(size) per price bin
volume_profile_path.poc_rule: max bin volume; tie-break center bin index (shared OA function)
volume_profile_path.note: Separate provenance and dedup path; same weighting measure as TPO-labeled path

reference_bracket_tpo.purpose: Audit-only reference for true time/bracket presence (not production TPO path)
reference_bracket_tpo.unit_per_bin: number of 30m brackets whose [low,high] touches bin

shared: weighting measure (base volume, not bracket time)
independent: aggregation location (CH server vs Python dedup)
integrity/prefix checks on volume side only
not_independent: underlying price-volume distribution when dedup yields identical bins
semantic measure (both are volume-at-price, not time TPO vs volume)
